description:
ONE PAGE of the project's decisions across all intents, newest first — architectural choices, trade-offs, and the constraints they respected.

Max 100 rows. If `hasMore`, you are holding a prefix, not the history: walk it with
`offset`, or better, use get_relevant_context for the decisions that bear on your
task. For the whole corpus (export, audit), use Kawa Code, not this tool.

Returns: decisions (this page, with intent context), count / totalCount / hasMore.

Each decision is summary-only — call get_decision_detail(decisionId) for rationale/context/consequences/alternatives:
- intentIds: owning intents (a decision can span several)
- type: fork, abandoned, discovery, constraint, tradeoff, or dependency
- summary, relatedFiles, constraintViolations

repoOrigin.description: Git remote origin URL. Auto-detected from repoPath via git if not provided.

repoPath.description: Local path to the repository root

name: get_project_decisions
